amino_acid_symbol_count.calculation: count uppercase standard, U, O, B, X, Z or J symbols
amino_acid_symbol_count.missing_behavior: null with component_status; valid independent counts survive
amino_acid_symbol_count.population: retained product; '*' and invalid symbols excluded

codon_validation.calculation: Finite IUPAC expansion of each retained codon against frozen reference entries; forward entries take precedence over stop membership internally; CDS first codon requires all expansions be starts and M; CDS last requires all expansions be stops and omission. Pure stop/AA ambiguity yields X; D/N -> B, E/Q -> Z, I/L -> J, otherwise X.
codon_validation.meaning: deterministic compatibility of transformation, not biological confidence
